I tried to load the "March Deals" worksheet but couldn't retrieve any rows.

What I did:
- Attempted to read the worksheet "March Deals" via the Google Sheets tool (google_sheets_get_many_rows). Result: 0 rows returned / no data found.

I can't calculate commissions or send the emails until I can read the source data. Please do one of the following so I can proceed (pick any):

1) Share the spreadsheet ID or a shareable link to the spreadsheet and confirm the sheet named "March Deals" is accessible to this agent.  
2) Paste the worksheet data (including headers) here or upload a CSV export of the "March Deals" sheet. Required columns (or equivalent): Rep name/email, Deal Value, Status, Notes (if Notes might contain "Referral"), and any Deal ID or descriptor you want preserved in messages. When you paste data, I will preserve source values verbatim in all notifications.  
3) If you want me to proceed using assumptions/hypothetical data, tell me to "Proceed with assumptions" — I will then 1) assume typical column names and example rows, 2) compute commissions using your tier rules and referral bonus, and 3) prepare/send the emails (but those notifications will contain fabricated example values unless you provide real data).

Once you provide access or the data, I'll:
- Filter to Status = "Won".  
- Apply tiered commission by Deal Value: under $25,000 = 6%; $25,000–$75,000 = 9%; above $75,000 = 12%.  
- Add $500 flat bonus for deals whose Notes contain the word "Referral".  
- Sum each rep's commission (preserving the original Deal Value and Notes verbatim in any messages that list deals).  
- Email each rep their commission amount.  
- Email payroll@company.example.com a summary with every rep's name and total and the grand total liability.

Tell me which option you choose or provide the sheet/CSV and I'll run the calculations and send the emails.
